Chapter 01 • Data Origin

The Copernicus Satellite Fleet Powering European Insights

NUPSI systematically collects optical, radar, and atmospheric Earth Observation data from European Space Agency (ESA) and Copernicus Sentinel missions, transforming raw orbital passes into seamless data feeds.

RADAR SAR

Sentinel-1

C-Band Synthetic Aperture Radar

Day-and-night all-weather radar imaging. Measures terrain subsidence, flood extents, infrastructure stability, and seasonal ice dynamics.

MULTISPECTRAL

Sentinel-2

13 Optical & Infrared Bands

High-resolution optical imagery (up to 10m). The backbone for vegetation indexes (NDVI), agricultural crop health, and land consumption.

OCEAN & LAND

Sentinel-3

Topography & Surface Temperature

Wide-swath land and sea surface temperature, ocean wave altimetry, and continuous continental hydrological tracking.

ATMOSPHERE

Sentinel-5P

High-Sensitivity TROPOMI Sensor

Air quality and atmospheric trace gases: daily mapping of nitrogen dioxide (NO₂), ozone (O₃), methane (CH₄), and aerosols over cities.

Chapter 02 • Thematic Domains

Different Visualizations Depending on User Needs

As defined in the NUPSI project framework, raw satellite passes are structured into 7 core thematic areas ready for analytics and operational decisions.

Open catalog in the app arrow_forward

The Air We Breathe

Atmospheric pollutant concentrations (NO₂, particulate matter, carbon monoxide) monitored continuously over European metropolitan basins.

Sentinel-5P TROPOMI Monthly

The Cities We Live

Urban Heat Island (UHI) effects, built-up density, surface impermeability, and municipal urban green ratios in GISCO communes.

Sentinel-2 & S3 10m / 300m

Extraordinary Events

Rapid hazard assessment and damage tracking for wildfires, volcanic eruptions, flash flooding, and extreme storm impacts.

Multi-Sensor On-Demand Near-Real-Time

Frozen Landscape

Cryosphere dynamics: seasonal alpine snow cover extent, glacier retreat velocity, and high-latitude permafrost indicators.

Sentinel-1 SAR + S2 Multi-temporal

Water on Land

Reservoirs, lakes, river basin hydrological capacity, and normalized moisture indexes (NDWI) for drought monitoring.

Sentinel-1 SAR & S2 Monthly

Land Life and Use

Precision agriculture, forest canopy cover change, vegetative vigor indexes (NDVI, EVI), and agricultural classification.

Sentinel-2 L2A 10m Mosaics

Ocean Insight

European coastal water monitoring, chlorophyll-a algal blooms, marine surface temperature patterns, and river sediment plumes.

Sentinel-3 OLCI & SLSTR Coastal & Marine

Chapter 03 • Territorial Querying

Customised Processing: Tailoring Spatial and Time Ranges

No more manual tiling and geospatial clipping. NUPSI gives you 4 straightforward methods to define your area of interest (AOI):

domain

GISCO Communes

Instant search across all official Eurostat GISCO municipalities with verified administrative boundaries.

data_object

Ingesting GeoJSON

Upload custom GeoJSON files or polygon shapes to crop satellite observations directly over your project area.

map

Selecting NUTS

Seamless filtering across standardized European NUTS-1 (macroregions), NUTS-2 (regions), and NUTS-3 (provinces).

polyline

Custom Selection

Draw interactive bounding boxes or freeform polygons directly on the MapLibre canvas for ad-hoc queries.

NUTS 2024 Geometry Overlay
Standardized Spatial Framework

Automated Extraction by European Region

NUPSI connects satellite rasters directly with Eurostat administrative registries. When selecting any European region or province, cloud-masked Sentinel mosaics are retrieved and clipped in seconds without GIS desktop software.

1,166 NUTS-3 Units • 242 NUTS-2 Regions
calendar_month MULTI-TEMPORAL TIMELINE

Timeline of Monthly Earth Observation Data

Inspect changes over identical geographic areas across months and years. The app's integrated timeline slider allows rapid scrubbing through cloudless monthly mosaics with split-screen comparison tools.

Interactive Temporal Slider Dual Split-Screen Mode
bar_chart INTEGRATED STATISTICAL TELEMETRY

Statistical Information Over Visualized Data

Beyond cartographic maps, NUPSI computes real-time histograms, variation curves, and spectral distribution tables for the selected polygon, exportable directly to CSV and GeoTIFF.

Indexes: NDVI, NDWI, NBR, NO₂ Export GeoTIFF / CSV
Chapter 04 • Cloud Engine

A Scalable, Open Cloud Infrastructure

Behind NUPSI's clean interface operates an enterprise microservices architecture deployed on Kubernetes, S3 distributed object storage, and STAC indexing.

sync

Systematic Processing

Copernicus satellite data are continuously collected, merged, and tailored over administrative boundaries, stored on high-throughput S3 buckets.

database

STAC Indexing

All produced assets are indexed via STAC (SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog), guaranteeing seamless interoperability with QGIS, Python, and R.

calculate

Band Math Processor

Dynamic raster algebra and visualization algorithms evaluated on-the-fly via specialized middleware services (TiTiler).

memory

On-Demand Processing

Complex analytical user requests are served dynamically by on-demand compute workers hosted on Kubernetes infrastructure.

folder_shared

User Workspace Storage

Dedicated cloud workspace for registered users to save custom polygons, schedule periodic downloads, and store processed products.

speed

CDN Caching

Content Delivery Network (CDN) caching raster image pyramids to ensure instant responsivity during multi-temporal map navigation.
